rubrics.justification: Generally consistent with the provided 3AB grading, especially compact ICM and looser TE, but it adds uncertain image-specific details (ICM location, subtle blastocoel visibility, minimal fragmentation) and shows some confusion about expansion/staging.
Integrates age, ovarian reserve, PCOS, prior IVF outcomes, endometrium, BMI, lifestyle, and paternal factors well, with reasonable discussion of how these modify prognosis alongside embryo quality.

Overall logical and structured, with conclusions broadly supported by morphology and clinical context; minor issues include speculative comments about endometrial thickness/progesterone and some inconsistency around exact blastocyst stage.

Mostly aligned with standard IVF practice: recognizes 3AB as a good but not top-tier Day 5 blastocyst, supports single embryo transfer, avoids unsupported add-ons, and appropriately frames PGT-A as optional rather than mandatory at age 34.

Provides practical next steps for transfer and future planning, including SET, luteal/endometrial review, cavity assessment, selective metabolic workup, and consideration of FET/PGT-A if failures continue; recommendations are useful though some are somewhat broad.
